skipped bone writes retain clock and notifies then apply the current pose
actual Rapier collision geometry changes independently of rendering

limits: Opt-in RuntimeLOD affects AnimationGraph bone writes and sprite frame presentation. Logical graph time, evaluation, curves, actor-root transforms and notifies continue each frame

Root motion, montage, retarget source and physics/skin-linked actors always refresh their pose. Legacy skeletal Animator mixer evaluation, IK calculations, bone-count LOD, interpolation, occlusion/frustum significance and dynamic CPU-ms animation budgets are separate work
Only a primary runtime camera supplies distance. Auto mode uses XY for ordinary 2D sprites and XYZ for models/billboards; explicit XY/XZ/XYZ are available. There is no camera/GPU visibility readback

Collision LOD is an explicit WorldCollision.lodMode=runtime choice and a RuntimeLOD distance band. Fixed mode is unchanged; dynamic rigid bodies keep fixed collision. Requested bands clamp to available top-level LOD assets; nested LOD assets keep their own fixed collision levels
runtimeLOD.collisionLevel in actor debug identifies the requested band, not an additional geometry level when the source asset contains fewer levels

Collision geometry cache is estimated, bounded to32MiB by default; active actors retain their installed arrays after cache eviction. This estimate is not process RAM/VRAM, FPS, or mobile thermal evidence
Runtime collision shape changes apply at the next synchronized physics update. C++ forced-level writes use existing Components::SetFloat; the proof waits for that physics update before ray queries
failedAttempts: First 5Hz schedule used remainder at a floating-point boundary and produced40 writes in4s. Subtracting elapsed intervals with a clamped remainder gives20 writes at30/60/120Hz

First native ray proof compared the nearest hit in a fixture with overlapping terrain/actors. Near hit was another surface at y1; target-filtered RaycastAll now proves the intended collider at y0.5 then10.5
First game sample used40 requestAnimationFrames and assumed at least0.3s. High-refresh displays can finish sooner; sampling now uses0.6s of simulation time and records samples before assertions
Early validation test used a guessed export name; switched to the actual validPhysicsSnapshot export before physics assertions
